name: application
description: One job application the user submitted to one posting (e.g. id app_saramin_10000001). Status moves applied -> viewed -> passed/rejected, or withdrawn.

vague_terms.빠르게 열람 / quickly viewed: viewed within 1 day of applying: elapsed from applied_at to viewed_at, unit days, op lte, value 1

company_id.description: Entity id of the company applied to, e.g. 'co_gasangtech'.

posting_id.description: Entity id of the posting applied to, e.g. 'posting_saramin_10000001'.

platform.description: Platform the application was submitted through.

status.description: Current status. applied: submitted; viewed: the company opened the application; passed: passed document screening; rejected: rejected; withdrawn: the user withdrew. The value is the CURRENT state only — whether a record ever reached a status (e.g. 'was viewed', even if later rejected) is answered from its history with the 'reached' filter. Outcome: passed and rejected are outcomes; applied and viewed mean no outcome yet (being viewed is not an outcome); withdrawn means the user cancelled.

applied_at.description: Date the application was submitted, YYYY-MM-DD in the user's time zone. Empty when it was not recorded (such records are left out of date filters, and answers say how many).

viewed_at.description: Date the company first viewed the application, YYYY-MM-DD in the user's time zone.

expected_rate.description: Free-form expected pass likelihood noted when applying, e.g. 'top10' or 'low'.
